exercises.q: Find and correct the error: "To ensure that you have prepared thoroughly, review your resume and practice answering common questions."
exercises.answer: Ensure that you have prepared thoroughly, review your resume and practice answering common questions.
exercises.explain: 祈使句应以动词原形 Ensure 开头，不能带 to。

grammar.key: If-conditional (Type 1: Real Present/Future) / If条件句（第一类：真实现在/未来）
grammar.title: 真实条件句（第一类）：if 引导的现在/未来真实条件及其与祈使句、情态动词的连用
grammar.titleEn: Type 1 Conditionals: Real Present/Future Conditions with Imperatives and Modals
grammar.usage:
第一类条件句用于表达现在或未来可能发生、真实存在的条件，以及在该条件下很可能产生的结果。它的核心结构是：if 从句使用一般现在时，主句根据表达需要选择祈使句、will/can/may 等情态动词加动词原形，或一般现在时。

肯定句结构为“If + 主语 + 一般现在时，主语 + will/can/may + 动词原形”，例如“If it rains, we will stay at home.”。否定句可以在 if 从句中用 don't/doesn't，也可以在主句中用 won't/can't，例如“If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.”。疑问句通常对主句部分提问，例如“What will you do if he doesn't come?”，注意 if 从句内部仍保持陈述语序。

第一类条件句与第二类条件句（虚拟条件句）的核心区别在于：第一类表达真实或很可能实现的条件，第二类表达与现在事实相反或不太可能实现的条件。例如“If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.”（真实可能）与“If I were you, I would go.”（虚拟假设）。此外，第一类条件句的主句不一定非要用 will，高中阶段应重点掌握主句使用祈使句、情态动词 can/may/must 以及“be going to”等结构的情况。

初中阶段通常只要求掌握“if + 一般现在时，主句用 will”这一基本模式，而高中阶段需要进一步拓展：主句可以用祈使句表示建议或指令，如“If you feel tired, take a break.”；可以用 can 表示能力或可能性，如“If you finish early, you can leave.”；可以用 may 表示许可或不确定的结果，如“If the weather is good, we may go hiking.”；还可以用 must/should 表示义务或建议。

易错点一：if 从句中不能用 will 表示将来，即使语义指向未来，也要用一般现在时。易错点二：当主句是祈使句时，句末用句号或感叹号，不要误加 will。易错点三：“if”引导的从句放在句首时，主句前要加逗号；从句放在主句之后时，通常不加逗号。易错点四：unless 相当于“if...not”，但语气更强，高中写作中可适当替换使用，注意不要与 if 否定句重复否定。
forms: If + 主语 + 一般现在时，主语 + will + 动词原形
If + 主语 + 一般现在时，祈使句
If + 主语 + 一般现在时，主语 + can/may/must/should + 动词原形
If + 主语 + 一般现在时，主语 + be going to + 动词原形
祈使句 + if + 主语 + 一般现在时（如：Call me if you need help.）
What will you do if + 主语 + 一般现在时...?（疑问句结构）
notes: if 从句中一律不用 will 表示将来，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
主句用祈使句时，整个句子仍属于第一类条件句，不要因为句中没有 will 就误判为其他类型。
在书面语中，if 从句置于句首时主句前必须加逗号；从句后置时一般不加逗号，注意标点规范。
unless 可替换“if...not”，但 unless 本身已含否定意义，不要再加 not，避免双重否定。
高考写作中，第一类条件句的主句可灵活使用情态动词，避免通篇只用 will，以体现语言多样性。

examples.en: If you mix red and yellow, you get orange.
examples.cn: 如果你把红色和黄色混合，就会得到橙色。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.cn: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

examples.en: If you feel tired, take a short break.
examples.cn: 如果你感到累了，就休息一会儿。

examples.en: If you finish your homework early, you can watch TV for a while.
examples.cn: 如果你早点完成作业，就可以看一会儿电视。

examples.en: If the weather is fine this weekend, we may go hiking in the mountains.
examples.cn: 如果这个周末天气好，我们可能会去山里徒步。

examples.en: Unless immediate action is taken, the situation is likely to worsen.
examples.cn: 除非立即采取行动，否则局势可能会恶化。

exercises.q: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: if 引导的条件句用一般现在时表示将来，不用 will。

exercises.q: If you feel tired, ______ a short break.
exercises.explain: if 条件句的主句可以用祈使句表示建议。

exercises.q: If she ______ early, she can catch the bus.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 can 表示可能的结果。

exercises.q: ______ you study hard, you will pass the exam.
exercises.explain: if 引导条件状语从句，表示“如果”。

exercises.q: If he ______ now, he will not be late.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时表示将来的动作。

exercises.q: If you ______ (need) help, please call me.
exercises.explain: if 条件句用一般现在时，主语是 you，动词用原形。

exercises.q: If it is sunny, we ______ (go) to the park.
exercises.explain: 主句用 will 加动词原形表示将来的结果。

exercises.q: If you ______ (not hurry), you will miss the train.
exercises.explain: if 从句否定形式用 don't 加动词原形。

exercises.q: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: if 从句不能用 will，应用一般现在时 rains。

exercises.q: If you feel sad, talk to your parents.
exercises.explain: if 条件句的主句可以用祈使句，结构正确。

exercises.q: If you work hard, you will succeed. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: If you don't work hard, you will not succeed.
exercises.explain: if 从句和主句都改为否定形式。

exercises.q: If it is hot, open the window. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: If it is hot, will you open the window?
exercises.explain: 将祈使句主句改为 will 开头的疑问句。

exercises.q: If you don't hurry, you will be late. (用 unless 改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you hurry, you will be late.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if not，后接肯定形式。

exercises.q: If you will come to my house, I will show you my new bike.
exercises.answer: If you come to my house, I will show you my new bike.
exercises.explain: if 从句中不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 come。

exercises.q: If he don't feel well, he will see a doctor.
exercises.answer: If he doesn't feel well, he will see a doctor.
exercises.explain: 主语 he 是第三人称单数，否定用 doesn't。

exercises.q: If you ______ to the party, you will meet many new friends.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时表示将来的条件。

exercises.q: If we don't protect the environment, many animals ______ their homes.
exercises.explain: 主句用 will 加动词原形表示可能的结果。

exercises.q: You can't enter the cinema if you ______ a ticket.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，否定用 don't have。

exercises.q: If you want to keep healthy, ______ more exercise.
exercises.explain: 主句用祈使句表示建议，动词用原形。

exercises.q: If she ______ the answer, she will tell us.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 she 用 knows。

exercises.q: If you ______ (not understand) the question, ask your teacher.
exercises.explain: if 从句否定用 don't 加动词原形。

exercises.q: If he ______ (arrive) early, we can start the meeting on time.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 he 用 arrives。

exercises.q: If there is no water, plants ______ (die).
exercises.explain: 主句用 will 加动词原形表示必然的结果。

exercises.q: If you will study hard, you will get good grades.
exercises.explain: if 从句不能用 will，应改为 study。

exercises.q: If you feel hungry, you can eat some bread.
exercises.explain: 主句用 can 表示可能的选择，结构正确。

exercises.q: If you don't leave now, you will miss the bus. (用 unless 改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you leave now, you will miss the bus.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if not，后接肯定形式。

exercises.q: If it rains, we will cancel the picnic. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Will you cancel the picnic if it rains?
exercises.explain: 将主句改为 will 开头的疑问句，if 从句保持一般现在时。

exercises.q: If you are tired, go to bed early. (用 should 改写主句)
exercises.answer: If you are tired, you should go to bed early.
exercises.explain: 主句可以用 should 表示建议，语气更委婉。

exercises.q: If he will call me, I will tell him the news.
exercises.answer: If he calls me, I will tell him the news.
exercises.explain: if 从句不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 calls。

exercises.q: If you don't will hurry, you will be late for school.
exercises.answer: If you don't hurry, you will be late for school.
exercises.explain: if 从句否定形式是 don't 加动词原形，不能加 will。

exercises.q: If you ______ the instructions carefully, you won't make mistakes.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时表示条件，主句用将来时。

exercises.q: If he ______ more time, he will finish the project successfully.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 he 用 has。

exercises.q: You will not improve your English unless you ______ it every day.
exercises.explain: unless 从句同样用一般现在时表示条件。

exercises.q: If you are feeling stressed, ______ a deep breath and relax.
exercises.explain: 主句用祈使句表示建议，动词用原形。

exercises.q: If the weather ______ good tomorrow, we will go hiking.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时表示将来的天气状况。

exercises.q: If you ______ (not pay) attention in class, you will fall behind.
exercises.explain: if 从句否定用 don't 加动词原形。

exercises.q: If she ______ (keep) practicing, she will become a great pianist.
exercises.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主语 she 用 keeps。

exercises.q: If you mix red and blue, you ______ (get) purple.
exercises.explain: 表示客观事实时，主句也用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If you will see him, please give him this message.
exercises.explain: if 从句不能用 will，应改为 see。

exercises.q: If you heat ice, it melts.
exercises.explain: 表示科学事实时，if 从句和主句都用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If you don't water the plants, they will die. (用 unless 改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you water the plants, they will die.
exercises.explain: unless 相当于 if not，后接肯定形式。

exercises.q: If you practice every day, you can improve your skills. (用 be able to 改写主句)
exercises.answer: If you practice every day, you will be able to improve your skills.
exercises.explain: can 可以转换为 will be able to 表示将来的能力。

exercises.q: If you don't tell me the truth, I won't trust you. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: If you tell me the truth, I will trust you.
exercises.explain: 将 if 从句和主句都改为肯定形式。

exercises.q: If he will arrive on time, we can start the meeting as planned.
exercises.answer: If he arrives on time, we can start the meeting as planned.
exercises.explain: if 从句不能用 will，应改为一般现在时 arrives。

exercises.q: If you will not study hard, you will fail the exam.
exercises.answer: If you don't study hard, you will fail the exam.
exercises.explain: if 从句否定用 don't，不能用 will not。

exercises.q: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句中，if 从句用一般现在时表将来，不用 will。

exercises.q: If you feel tired, ______ a short break.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句的主句可以用祈使句表示建议或指令。

exercises.q: If she ______ hard, she will pass the exam.
exercises.explain: if 从句中主语是第三人称单数，动词用一般现在时第三人称单数形式。

exercises.q: You ______ miss the bus if you don't hurry.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句主句常用 will 表示将来可能的结果。

exercises.q: If you ______ any questions, ask your teacher.

grammar.key: Passive Voice (Present Simple) / 被动语态（一般现在时）
grammar.title: 被动语态（一般现在时）及其情态动词拓展
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice (Present Simple) with Modal Extensions
grammar.usage:
被动语态的核心结构是“be + 过去分词（V3）”，其中 be 动词需要根据主语的人称和数进行变化。在一般现在时中，be 的形式为 am / is / are。当句子的重点在于动作本身、动作的承受者，或者执行者不言自明、不重要、无法确定时，通常使用被动语态。例如，在招聘、通知、规则、流程说明等正式语境中，被动语态能有效弱化个人色彩，突出客观性。

肯定句结构为“主语 + am/is/are + 过去分词”，否定句在 be 动词后加 not，疑问句将 be 动词提到主语之前。例如：The uniforms are washed every day. / The uniforms are not washed every day. / Are the uniforms washed every day? 如果动作的执行者需要说明，可在句末用“by + 执行者”引出，但很多情况下 by 短语可以省略。

当被动语态与情态动词连用时，结构变为“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”。常见情态动词包括 can, could, must, should, may, might, need to, have to 等。例如：The rules must be followed. / The form needs to be filled in. 否定形式在情态动词后加 not，疑问形式将情态动词提前。这一结构在高中阶段尤其重要，因为它将被动语态从单纯时态层面拓展到了语气和态度层面。

初中阶段主要要求掌握一般现在时、一般过去时和一般将来时的被动语态，以及含情态动词的被动语态基本形式。高中阶段则进一步要求：在复杂句和从句中准确使用被动语态；区分“be + 过去分词”表示被动与“be + 形容词”表示状态；掌握“get + 过去分词”的口语化被动表达；理解被动语态在书面语、新闻报道、学术写作中的高频使用；并能将主动句与被动句进行灵活转换而不改变原意。

易错点一：混淆被动语态与系表结构。例如 The door is closed. 可以表示“门被关上了”（被动动作），也可以表示“门是关着的”（状态），需要根据语境判断。易错点二：不及物动词没有被动语态，如 happen, appear, disappear, belong to 等不能用于被动结构。易错点三：在情态动词被动结构中漏掉 be，例如误写为“The work must done”而不是“The work must be done”。易错点四：主动句变被动句时，时态和主谓一致容易出错，尤其是当主语为第三人称单数时，be 动词要用 is 而不是 are。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + am/is/are + 过去分词 (V3)
否定句：主语 + am/is/are + not + 过去分词 (V3)
一般疑问句：Am/Is/Are + 主语 + 过去分词 (V3)?
情态动词被动：主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词 (V3)
情态动词被动否定：主语 + 情态动词 + not + be + 过去分词 (V3)
带执行者：主语 + be + 过去分词 + by + 执行者
notes: 高考书面表达中，适当使用被动语态能提升文章的客观性和正式感，但不宜通篇使用，否则显得生硬。
注意“get + 过去分词”在口语和非正式书面语中可表示被动，如 get hurt, get caught，但正式写作中优先使用 be 被动。
不及物动词和部分短语动词没有被动语态，如 consist of, belong to, take place，写作时避免误用。
情态动词被动结构中，be 动词永远用原形，不受主语人称和数的影响。
在科技文、新闻和学术语域中，被动语态常省略 by 短语，以突出过程或结果而非执行者。

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 现在完成时：从“已完成”到“持续至今”的高中拓展用法
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense: From Completion to Duration
grammar.usage:
现在完成时的核心结构是“have/has + 过去分词”，用来连接过去与现在。它主要表达两种含义：一是过去发生的动作对现在造成了影响或结果，二是动作或状态从过去开始一直持续到现在。肯定句如“She has finished her work.”，否定句在 have/has 后加 not，如“He hasn't replied yet.”，疑问句把 have/has 提到主语前，如“Have you ever been to Shanghai?”。

与一般过去时相比，现在完成时强调“与现在的联系”，而一般过去时只陈述过去的事实。例如“I lost my key yesterday.”只说明昨天丢了钥匙，而“I have lost my key.”则暗示现在还没找到。与现在完成进行时相比，现在完成时更侧重结果或完成的动作，而现在完成进行时更强调动作的持续过程，如“I have read the book.”（读完了）与“I have been reading the book.”（一直在读，可能还没读完）。

初中阶段主要掌握“for + 时间段”和“since + 时间点”表示持续，以及 already、yet、ever、never、just 等标志词。高中阶段则需要进一步理解：现在完成时在新闻报道、学术写作中的高频使用，如“Researchers have found that...”；在“It is the first time that...”句型中的用法；以及瞬间动词在现在完成时中不能直接与时间段连用的限制。

易错点一：瞬间动词如 come、go、leave、die、buy 不能直接与 for 引导的时间段连用，需转换为延续性表达，如“He has been away for two weeks.”而非“He has left for two weeks.”。易错点二：since 后面接从句时，从句通常用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时，如“I have known her since she moved here.”。易错点三：have been to、have gone to、have been in 三者含义不同——have been to 表示“去过某地已回来”，have gone to 表示“去了某地还没回来”，have been in 表示“在某地待了多久”。易错点四：在“It is the first/second time that...”句型中，that 从句要用现在完成时，如“It is the first time that I have seen such a beautiful sunset.”。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + have/has + 过去分词
否定句：主语 + have/has + not + 过去分词
一般疑问句：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词?
持续用法：主语 + have/has + 过去分词 + for + 时间段 / since + 时间点
固定句型：It is the first/second time that + 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
被动语态：主语 + have/has + been + 过去分词
notes: 瞬间动词（come、go、leave、die、buy、borrow 等）不能直接与 for + 时间段连用，需改为延续性动词或状态表达，如 be away、be dead、have、keep。
since 引导时间状语从句时，从句用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时；since 后面也可直接接时间点名词。
高考书面语中，现在完成时常与 recently、lately、so far、up to now、in the past few years 等时间状语搭配，体现“迄今为止”的语域色彩。
在新闻报道和学术语体中，现在完成时常用来引出新发现或新结论，如“Studies have shown that...”，这是高中阅读和写作中的高频句式。
注意 have been to（去过已回）、have gone to（去了未回）、have been in（待了多久）三者的语义差异，高考单选和完形填空常在此设题。

examples.en: I have finished my homework, so I can watch TV now.
examples.cn: 我已经做完作业了，所以现在可以看电视了。

examples.en: She has lived in this city since 2018.
examples.cn: 她自2018年以来一直住在这座城市。

examples.en: Have you ever tried Chinese hot pot before?
examples.cn: 你以前吃过中国火锅吗？

examples.en: Scientists have recently discovered a potential link between sleep and memory.
examples.cn: 科学家们最近发现了睡眠与记忆之间的潜在联系。

examples.en: It is the third time that the company has changed its marketing strategy this year.
examples.cn: 这是该公司今年第三次改变营销策略。

examples.en: By now, several studies have shown that social isolation can significantly increase stress hormone levels.
examples.cn: 迄今为止，多项研究表明社交隔离会显著增加压力荷尔蒙水平。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework, so I can watch TV now.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时强调过去动作对现在的影响，作业已完成所以现在可以看电视。

exercises.q: She ______ in this school since 2020.
exercises.explain: since + 时间点常与现在完成时连用，表示从过去持续到现在的动作。

exercises.q: They ______ the movie already.
exercises.explain: already 常与现在完成时连用，表示动作已经完成。

exercises.q: My brother ______ his key, so he can't open the door.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去丢钥匙对现在造成影响——现在开不了门。

exercises.q: We ______ each other for three years.
exercises.explain: for + 时间段与现在完成时连用，表示持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: He ______ (live) in Beijing since he was ten.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时表示持续。

exercises.q: I ______ (not finish) my lunch yet.
exercises.explain: yet 用于否定句，表示还没有完成，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: ______ you ever ______ (be) to Shanghai?
exercises.explain: ever 用于现在完成时疑问句，询问是否曾经去过某地。

exercises.q: I have seen this film yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是明确的过去时间，不能与现在完成时连用，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: She has been a teacher for five years.
exercises.explain: for + 时间段与现在完成时连用，表示持续到现在的状态，句子正确。

exercises.q: I have done my homework. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: I have not done my homework.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定句在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.q: He has finished his work. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时一般疑问句将 has/have 提到主语前。

exercises.q: They have been to the park. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: They have not been to the park.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定句在 have 后加 not。

exercises.q: I have saw the new movie.
exercises.answer: I have seen the new movie.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时中动词要用过去分词，see 的过去分词是 seen。

exercises.q: She have lived here for two years.
exercises.answer: She has lived here for two years.
exercises.explain: 主语是第三人称单数时，现在完成时用 has 而不是 have。

exercises.q: The research team ______ the experiment three times so far.
exercises.explain: so far 常与现在完成时连用，表示到目前为止已经完成的动作。

exercises.q: I ______ my best friend since primary school.
exercises.explain: since + 时间点与现在完成时连用，表示从过去持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: She can't go out because she ______ her homework yet.
exercises.explain: yet 用于否定句，现在完成时表示动作尚未完成，对现在造成影响。

exercises.q: This is the first time I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: This is the first time 句型中从句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The scientists ______ a new way to reduce stress hormones recently.
exercises.explain: recently 常与现在完成时连用，表示最近发生的动作对现在有影响。

exercises.q: How long ______ you ______ (study) English?
exercises.explain: How long 询问持续时间，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The lack of social interactions ______ (show) to increase stress hormones.
exercises.explain: 主语是 the lack，为单数，用 has + 过去分词。

exercises.q: They ______ (not see) each other since last summer.
exercises.explain: since + 过去时间点与现在完成时连用，否定形式为 have not + 过去分词。

exercises.q: He has gone to Beijing last week.
exercises.explain: last week 是明确的过去时间，不能与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: I have never been to Japan.
exercises.explain: never 用于现在完成时，表示从未有过某种经历，句子正确。

exercises.q: She has already finished the report. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: She has not finished the report yet.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定句中 already 通常改为 yet。

exercises.q: They have lived in this city for ten years. (对划线部分提问)
exercises.answer: How long have they lived in this city?
exercises.explain: 对 for + 时间段提问用 How long，后接现在完成时。

exercises.q: I have read this book. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时一般疑问句将 have 提到主语前，人称做相应变化。

exercises.q: The students has finished their project.
exercises.answer: The students have finished their project.
exercises.explain: 主语 students 是复数，现在完成时用 have 而不是 has。

exercises.q: I have never saw such a wonderful performance.
exercises.answer: I have never seen such a wonderful performance.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时中动词用过去分词，see 的过去分词是 seen。

exercises.q: By the time the doctor arrived, the patient ______ consciousness.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间状语从句，主句用过去完成时表示先于从句动作发生。

exercises.q: It is reported that the lack of social interactions ______ to increase stress hormones.
exercises.explain: It is reported that 后接现在完成时，表示研究结果对现在仍有影响。

exercises.q: She ______ in this company since she graduated from university.
exercises.explain: since 引导过去时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时表示持续到现在的动作。

exercises.q: The number of people suffering from loneliness ______ significantly over the past decade.
exercises.explain: over the past decade 常与现在完成时连用，表示从过去持续到现在的变化。

exercises.q: This is the most interesting book I ______.
exercises.explain: This is the most... I have ever... 句型中从句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: It is the first time that the researchers ______ (observe) such a phenomenon.
exercises.explain: It is the first time that 句型中从句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The committee ______ (not reach) a final decision yet.
exercises.explain: committee 在此视为整体，用单数 has，yet 用于否定句。

exercises.q: Over the years, technology ______ (change) the way we communicate.
exercises.explain: over the years 与现在完成时连用，表示从过去到现在的持续变化。

exercises.q: The study has been conducted in 2019.
exercises.explain: in 2019 是明确的过去时间，不能与现在完成时连用，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: Scientists have made great progress in understanding stress hormones recently.
exercises.explain: recently 与现在完成时连用，表示最近取得的进展对现在有影响。

exercises.q: She has been studying English for six years. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Has she been studying English for six years?
exercises.explain: 现在完成进行时一般疑问句将 has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: They have not finished the experiment yet. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: They have already finished the experiment.
exercises.explain: 否定句转肯定句时，yet 改为 already，去掉 not。

exercises.q: I have never met such a kind person. (改为同义句)
exercises.answer: This is the kindest person I have ever met.
exercises.explain: 用最高级句型改写，保持现在完成时表达经历。

exercises.q: The data have shown that the lack of social interactions increase stress hormones.
exercises.answer: The data has shown that the lack of social interactions increases stress hormones.
exercises.explain: data 在此视为整体用单数 has，从句主语 the lack 也用单数 increases。

exercises.q: She has been worked in this hospital for over ten years.
exercises.answer: She has worked in this hospital for over ten years.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时结构为 has + 过去分词，worked 前不需要 been。

exercises.q: I ______ my English homework yet. Can I do it tomorrow?
exercises.explain: yet 常与现在完成时连用，表示“还没有完成”。

exercises.q: She ______ in this city since 2018.
exercises.explain: since 2018 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: My brother ______ his leg, so he can't play football with us now.
exercises.explain: 过去受伤对现在造成影响（不能踢球），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: We ______ each other for ten years. We are still good friends.
exercises.explain: for ten years 表示持续到现在的状态，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: — Where is Tom? — He ______ to the library. He'll be back in an hour.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示“去了某地还没回来”，符合语境。

exercises.q: I ______ (see) this movie twice. It's really good.
exercises.explain: twice 表示经历，用现在完成时 have seen。

exercises.q: She ______ (not eat) anything since this morning.
exercises.explain: since this morning 与现在完成时连用，否定形式为 has not eaten。

exercises.q: They ______ already ______ (finish) their project.
exercises.explain: already 常与现在完成时连用，结构为 have finished。

exercises.q: The sentence "He has bought the car last week." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: last week 是明确的过去时间，不能与现在完成时连用，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have lived here for five years." means I still live here now.
exercises.explain: for five years 与现在完成时连用表示动作持续到现在。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: She has finished her work.
exercises.answer: She has not finished her work.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定形式在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a yes/no question: They have visited the museum.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句将 have/has 提前到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "already": I have done my homework.
exercises.answer: I have already done my homework.
exercises.explain: already 通常放在 have/has 和过去分词之间。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: He have lived here for three years.
exercises.answer: He has lived here for three years.
exercises.explain: 主语 He 是第三人称单数，应用 has 而不是 have。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: I have saw that film before.
exercises.answer: I have seen that film before.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时中过去分词应为 seen，而不是 saw。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived at the station, the train ______.
exercises.explain: arrived 是过去动作，火车离开发生在 arrived 之前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: This is the first time I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: This is the first time 句型中从句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ in the lab for three hours and she is still working.
exercises.explain: 强调从过去持续到现在且仍在进行的动作，用现在完成进行时。

exercises.q: I ______ my keys. I can't find them anywhere.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙对现在造成影响（找不到），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ in this company since he graduated from college.
exercises.explain: since 引导的时间状语从句表示从过去持续到现在，主句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: The researchers ______ (conduct) several experiments on this topic so far.
exercises.explain: so far 表示“到目前为止”，与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: It is the most interesting book I ______ ever ______ (read).
exercises.explain: 最高级与 ever 连用，用现在完成时表示经历。

exercises.q: She ______ (be) to Beijing three times, and she wants to go again.
exercises.explain: has been to 表示“去过某地”，强调经历。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have known him since two years." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: since 后接时间点，two years 是时间段，应改为 for two years。

exercises.q: The sentence "She has gone to Shanghai and will return next week." means she is in Shanghai now.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示“去了某地”，人还在那里。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "since": I started learning English in 2015 and I still learn it.
exercises.explain: since 后接时间点，主句用现在完成时表示持续。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "for": He moved to this city five years ago and still lives here.
exercises.answer: He has lived in this city for five years.
exercises.explain: for 后接时间段，用现在完成时表示持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "just": She finished her homework a moment ago.
exercises.answer: She has just finished her homework.
exercises.explain: just 表示“刚刚”，与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: I have been knowing him for many years.
exercises.answer: I have known him for many years.
exercises.explain: know 是状态动词，通常不用进行时态，应改为 have known。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She has left her hometown for three years.
exercises.answer: She has been away from her hometown for three years.

exercises.q: The lack of social interactions ______ to increase stress hormones, according to the report.

exercises.q: By the end of last year, the team ______ more than 500 cases.

exercises.q: Hardly ______ the researchers ______ (begin) the experiment when the equipment failed.

exercises.explain: last month 是明确的过去时间，不能与现在完成时连用，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: The sentence "She has been studying the phenomenon since she joined the institute." implies she is still studying it.
exercises.explain: 现在完成进行时表示从过去持续到现在且仍在进行的动作。

exercises.explain: since 后接时间点，用现在完成进行时表示持续到现在的动作。

exercises.answer: The results of the study have been analyzed by the team.

exercises.answer: She has been the director of the institute since 2020.
exercises.explain: appoint 是短暂性动词，不能与 since 时间段连用，应改为持续性表达。

grammar.key: Modal Verbs for Speculation / 表示推测的情态动词
grammar.title: 情态动词表推测：must / may / might / could / can’t 的用法与拓展
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verbs for Speculation: must, may, might, could, can’t and Their Extended Uses
grammar.usage:
情态动词表推测用于对现在、过去或将来情况的可能性进行判断。核心结构为“情态动词 + 动词原形”表示对现在或将来的推测，以及“情态动词 + have + 过去分词”表示对过去的推测。肯定句中，must 表示把握最大的肯定推测（“一定、肯定”），may / might / could 表示中等或较弱可能性（“可能、也许”），其中 might 和 could 语气比 may 更弱、更委婉。否定推测用 can’t 或 couldn’t，表示“不可能”，注意 mustn’t 不用于推测，而是表示“禁止”。疑问句中常用 can / could 询问可能性，如“Can it be true?”，而 must 表推测时一般不用于疑问句。

与近义结构对比时，must 表推测与 have to 不同：have to 表示客观义务，不表推测。may / might / could 三者都可表“可能”，但 might 和 could 还可用于委婉建议或请求，而 may 更正式。can 表推测时多用于否定和疑问，不用于肯定推测；could 则肯定、否定、疑问均可使用。初中阶段主要掌握 must / may / might / can’t 加动词原形的基本推测用法；高中阶段则需进一步掌握“情态动词 + have done”对过去的推测、could 表弱可能性、以及不同情态动词在语域和语气上的细微差别。

易错点一：must 表推测的否定形式不是 mustn’t，而是 can’t 或 couldn’t。易错点二：could 表推测时不是 can 的过去式，而是表示现在或将来的弱可能性，需根据语境判断。易错点三：对过去情况的推测必须用“情态动词 + have done”，不能只用“情态动词 + 动词原形”。易错点四：may 和 might 在表推测时，might 并非 may 的过去式，两者都可指现在或将来，只是 might 语气更不确定。
forms: must + 动词原形 / be：表示对现在或将来情况把握很大的肯定推测
may / might / could + 动词原形 / be：表示对现在或将来情况的中等或较弱可能性推测
can’t / couldn’t + 动词原形 / be：表示对现在或将来情况的否定推测（不可能）
must / may / might / could / can’t + have + 过去分词：表示对过去情况的推测
Can / Could + 主语 + 动词原形...?：用于疑问句中询问可能性
情态动词 + be doing：表示对正在进行的动作的推测
notes: must 表推测时，其否定形式是 can’t 或 couldn’t，不能用 mustn’t；mustn’t 只表示“禁止、不准”。
could 表推测时不是 can 的过去式，而是表示现在或将来的弱可能性；在书面语中，could 表推测比 can 更常见。
对过去情况的推测必须用“情态动词 + have done”结构，高考中常考 must have done（一定做过）、may/might have done（可能做过）、can’t have done（不可能做过）。
may 表推测时语气比 might 稍强，但在正式书面语中，might 常被用于表示更谨慎、更委婉的推测，符合学术写作的语域要求。
can 表推测时通常只用于否定句和疑问句，不用于肯定句；肯定句中表“可能”要用 could、may 或 might。

examples.en: It might rain later, so take an umbrella.
examples.cn: 稍后可能会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

examples.en: He must be at home because the lights are on.
examples.cn: 他一定在家，因为灯亮着。

examples.en: She can’t be serious—she’s just joking with you.
examples.cn: 她不可能是认真的——她只是在跟你开玩笑。

examples.en: They could have taken the wrong bus, which is why they are late.
examples.cn: 他们可能坐错了公交车，所以迟到了。

examples.en: The results of the experiment may have been affected by temperature changes.
examples.cn: 实验结果可能受到了温度变化的影响。

examples.en: Given the lack of evidence, the committee might well conclude that no further action is necessary.
examples.cn: 鉴于缺乏证据，委员会很可能会得出无需采取进一步行动的结论。

exercises.q: The lights are on in the classroom. Someone ______ be there.
exercises.explain: 灯亮着说明很可能有人，must 表示很有把握的肯定推测。

exercises.q: It ______ rain later, so take an umbrella with you.
exercises.explain: could 表示将来可能发生，语气较弱。

exercises.q: He ______ be at home now. I just saw him in the library.
exercises.explain: 刚在图书馆看见他，所以不可能在家，can't 表示否定推测。

exercises.q: The phone is ringing. It ______ be my mother. She always calls at this time.
exercises.explain: could 表示一种可能性，不十分确定。

exercises.q: You look very tired. You ______ go to bed early tonight.
exercises.explain: should 表示建议，符合语境。

exercises.q: She isn't answering her phone. She ______ be sleeping.
exercises.explain: might 表示对现在情况的推测，可能性中等。

exercises.q: That ______ be Tom. He is much taller than that boy.
exercises.explain: can't 表示否定推测，意为不可能。

exercises.q: The sky is getting dark. It ______ rain soon.
exercises.explain: may 表示将来可能发生。

exercises.q: The sentence "He could be at the library now" means he is certainly at the library.
exercises.explain: could 表示可能，不是肯定。

exercises.q: The sentence "She can't be your sister. She is too young" means it is impossible that she is your sister.
exercises.explain: can't 表示否定推测，意为不可能。

exercises.q: Maybe he is at home. (用 could 改写)
exercises.explain: could be 表示对现在情况的推测。

exercises.q: It is possible that she is ill. (用 might 改写)
exercises.explain: might be 表示对现在情况的推测。

exercises.q: I am sure he is tired. (用 must 改写)
exercises.explain: must be 表示很有把握的肯定推测。

exercises.q: He musts be at school now.
exercises.answer: He must be at school now.
exercises.explain: 情态动词后接动词原形，must 不能加 s。

exercises.q: She can't is a teacher. She is too young.
exercises.answer: She can't be a teacher. She is too young.
exercises.explain: can't 后接动词原形 be，不能接 is。

exercises.q: The ground is wet. It ______ have rained last night.
exercises.explain: 地面湿说明昨晚很可能下过雨，must have done 表示对过去的肯定推测。

exercises.q: He ______ have gone to Beijing. I saw him in the office just now.
exercises.explain: 刚才在办公室看见他，所以不可能去了北京，can't have done 表示对过去的否定推测。

exercises.q: She looks very happy. She ______ have passed the exam.
exercises.explain: 她看起来很开心，所以很可能通过了考试，must have done 表示对过去的肯定推测。

exercises.q: I'm not sure where Tom is. He ______ be in the library or in the gym.
exercises.explain: 不确定他在哪里，could 表示可能性。

exercises.q: You ______ be hungry after such a long walk. Let's have something to eat.
exercises.explain: 走了这么长的路，一定饿了，must 表示很有把握的推测。

exercises.q: He ______ have finished his homework. He was playing games all evening.
exercises.explain: 整晚都在玩游戏，不可能完成了作业，can't have done 表示对过去的否定推测。

exercises.q: The door is locked. They ______ have gone out.
exercises.explain: 门锁着说明他们很可能出去了，must have done 表示对过去的肯定推测。

exercises.q: She isn't at home. She ______ be at work.
exercises.explain: might 表示对现在情况的推测，可能性中等。

exercises.q: The sentence "He must have been ill" means the speaker is certain that he was ill.
exercises.explain: must have done 表示对过去情况的肯定推测。

exercises.q: The sentence "She could have left early" means she certainly left early.
exercises.explain: could have done 表示过去可能发生，不是肯定。

exercises.q: I am sure he was at the party last night. (用 must 改写)
exercises.answer: He must have been at the party last night.
exercises.explain: must have been 表示对过去情况的肯定推测。

exercises.q: It is impossible that she said that. (用 can't 改写)
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测。

exercises.q: Maybe they missed the bus. (用 might 改写)
exercises.answer: They might have missed the bus.
exercises.explain: might have done 表示对过去情况的推测。

exercises.q: He must has finished his work.
exercises.answer: He must have finished his work.
exercises.explain: must have done 中 have 用原形，不能用 has。

exercises.q: She can't went to school yesterday.
exercises.answer: She can't have gone to school yesterday.
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去的否定推测，went 应改为 have gone。

exercises.q: He ______ have been to the meeting. He knew nothing about the decision.
exercises.explain: 他对决定一无所知，说明不可能参加过会议，can't have done 表示对过去的否定推测。

exercises.q: The streets are flooded. It ______ have rained heavily last night.
exercises.explain: 街道被淹说明昨晚一定下过大雨，must have done 表示对过去的肯定推测。

exercises.q: She ______ have received my message. She hasn't replied yet.
exercises.explain: 她还没回复，可能没收到信息，might not have done 表示过去可能没发生。

exercises.q: He looks exhausted. He ______ have been working all night.
exercises.explain: 他看起来很疲惫，一定工作了一整晚，must have been doing 表示对过去持续动作的推测。

exercises.q: The cake is gone. Someone ______ have eaten it.
exercises.explain: 蛋糕不见了，一定有人吃了，must have done 表示对过去的肯定推测。

exercises.q: He ______ have known the truth. He looked so surprised when he heard the news.
exercises.explain: 他听到消息时很惊讶，说明之前不可能知道真相，can't have done 表示对过去的否定推测。

exercises.q: She ______ have been waiting for a long time. She looked impatient.
exercises.explain: 她看起来不耐烦，一定等了很久，must have been doing 表示对过去持续动作的推测。

exercises.q: They ______ have arrived yet. The lights are still off.
exercises.explain: 灯还关着，说明他们不可能已经到了，can't have done 表示对过去的否定推测。

exercises.q: The sentence "He might have forgotten about the meeting" means the speaker is certain that he forgot.
exercises.explain: might have done 表示过去可能发生，不是肯定。

exercises.q: The sentence "She can't have been at home yesterday" means it is impossible that she was at home yesterday.
exercises.explain: can't have been 表示对过去情况的否定推测。

exercises.q: I am sure he was sleeping when I called. (用 must 改写)
exercises.answer: He must have been sleeping when I called.
exercises.explain: must have been doing 表示对过去某一时刻正在进行的动作的推测。

exercises.q: It is possible that she didn't understand the question. (用 might 改写)
exercises.answer: She might not have understood the question.
exercises.explain: might not have done 表示过去可能没有发生。

exercises.q: I am sure they have already left. (用 must 改写)
exercises.explain: must have done 表示对过去情况的肯定推测。

exercises.q: He must have went to the station early.
exercises.answer: He must have gone to the station early.
exercises.explain: must have done 中 have 后接过去分词，went 应改为 gone。

exercises.q: She can't have been finished her homework so quickly.
exercises.answer: She can't have finished her homework so quickly.
exercises.explain: can't have done 中 have 后直接接过去分词，不能加 been。

exercises.q: The lights are still on in the classroom. Someone ______ be inside.
exercises.explain: 灯还亮着，表示非常肯定的推测，用 must。

exercises.q: You look tired. You ______ go to bed earlier tonight.
exercises.explain: 表示建议，用 should。

exercises.q: That man ______ be Mr. Wang. Mr. Wang has gone to Beijing.
exercises.explain: 王先生已经去北京了，所以那个人不可能是他，用 can't 表示否定推测。

exercises.q: It's only seven o'clock. The museum ______ be closed now.
exercises.explain: 才七点钟，博物馆不可能关门，用 can't 表示否定推测。

exercises.q: I'm not sure where my keys are. They ______ be in my bag.
exercises.explain: 不确定钥匙在哪里，用 could 表示可能性。

exercises.q: She speaks English very well. She ______ be from England or America.
exercises.explain: 根据她英语说得好这一证据，做出非常肯定的推测，填 must。

exercises.q: He isn't answering his phone. He ______ be sleeping.
exercises.explain: 不接电话可能是在睡觉，表示可能性，填 might。

exercises.q: The ground is wet. It ______ have rained last night.
exercises.explain: 地面湿了，对过去情况做出肯定推测，用 must have done。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'He could be at home now', 'could' means he was able to be at home in the past.
exercises.explain: 这里的 could 表示现在或未来的可能性，不是过去的能力。

exercises.q: The sentence 'She must be very happy' expresses a strong possibility.
exercises.explain: must 表示非常肯定的推测，语气强烈。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'could': Maybe he is at the library.
exercises.answer: He could be at the library.
exercises.explain: 用 could 表示可能性，后接动词原形 be。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'must': I'm sure she is tired after the long trip.
exercises.answer: She must be tired after the long trip.
exercises.explain: 对现在情况的肯定推测用 must be。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'can't': It is impossible that he is at school today because it's Sunday.
exercises.answer: He can't be at school today because it's Sunday.
exercises.explain: 否定推测用 can't be。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: He musts be very busy these days.
exercises.answer: He must be very busy these days.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 must 后接动词原形，不能加 s。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She can't is at home because the lights are off.
exercises.answer: She can't be at home because the lights are off.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can't 后接动词原形 be，不能接 is。

exercises.q: The door is locked and no one answers. They ______ have gone out for dinner.
exercises.explain: 门锁着且无人应答，表示对过去情况的可能性推测，用 could have done。

exercises.q: You ______ be serious! That story sounds completely unbelievable.
exercises.explain: 表示强烈否定推测，认为某事不可能是真的，用 can't。

exercises.q: He ______ have finished the project already. It's only been two days since he started.
exercises.explain: 才两天时间，他不可能已经完成项目，对过去情况的否定推测用 can't have done。

exercises.q: She looks very pale. She ______ be feeling unwell.
exercises.explain: 脸色苍白可能是身体不舒服，用 could 表示可能性。

exercises.q: The test was extremely difficult. Many students ______ have passed it.
exercises.explain: 考试太难，很多学生不可能通过，对过去情况的否定推测用 couldn't have done。

exercises.q: I hear footsteps outside. There ______ be someone at the door.
exercises.explain: 听到脚步声，做出非常肯定的推测，填 must。

exercises.q: He ______ have forgotten about the meeting. He never misses appointments.
exercises.explain: 他从不缺席会议，所以不可能忘记，对过去情况的否定推测用 can't have done。

exercises.q: The cake is gone. Someone ______ have eaten it while we were out.
exercises.explain: 蛋糕不见了，对过去情况做出肯定推测，填 must have eaten。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'They could have arrived early', the speaker is certain that they arrived early.
exercises.explain: could have done 表示对过去情况的可能性推测，并非确定。

exercises.q: The sentence 'He can't have stolen the money' means it is impossible that he stole the money.
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测，意为不可能做过某事。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'might have': Perhaps she missed the bus.
exercises.answer: She might have missed the bus.
exercises.explain: 对过去情况的可能性推测用 might have done。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'must have': I'm sure they enjoyed the concert.
exercises.answer: They must have enjoyed the concert.
exercises.explain: 对过去情况的肯定推测用 must have done。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'could': It is possible that the news is true.
exercises.explain: 用 could 表示现在情况的可能性。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She must has left her umbrella at home.
exercises.answer: She must have left her umbrella at home.
exercises.explain: must 后接 have done，不能用 has done。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: He could be the thief because he was out of town that day.
exercises.answer: He couldn't be the thief because he was out of town that day.
exercises.explain: 他那天不在城里，所以不可能是小偷，应用否定推测 couldn't be。

exercises.q: Given the evidence presented at the trial, the defendant ______ have been at the scene of the crime.
exercises.explain: 根据庭审证据，被告不可能在犯罪现场，对过去情况的否定推测用 couldn't have done。

exercises.q: The professor's absence from the conference ______ be due to illness, but no one has confirmed it yet.
exercises.explain: 教授缺席可能因为生病，但尚未确认，用 could 表示不确定的推测。

exercises.q: With such a high fever, she ______ be feeling anything but miserable right now.
exercises.explain: 发高烧时她不可能感觉好，anything but miserable 表示绝非痛苦，用 can't 表示否定推测。

exercises.q: The ancient manuscript ______ have been written by a single author, as the writing styles vary significantly.
exercises.explain: 笔迹风格差异大，所以手稿不可能由一人写成，对过去情况的否定推测用 can't have done。

exercises.q: Considering his extensive experience in the field, he ______ be the most qualified candidate for the position.
exercises.explain: 考虑到他的丰富经验，他可能是最合格的候选人，用 could 表示可能性。

exercises.q: The experiment failed repeatedly. The hypothesis ______ have been flawed from the start.
exercises.explain: 实验反复失败，假设从一开始就可能有缺陷，对过去情况的肯定推测用 must have done。

exercises.q: She speaks with a perfect British accent. She ______ have spent years living in London.

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语（含不定式对比与高中拓展）
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject (with Infinitive Contrast and Senior-Level Extension)
grammar.usage:
动名词作主语是英语中把“动作”当作“事情”来谈论的核心手段。动名词由“动词原形 + -ing”构成，在句中具有名词性质，可以单独作主语，也可以带上自己的宾语、状语等构成动名词短语作主语。核心结构为：动名词（短语）+ 谓语动词（单数）+ 其他成分。例如：Reading helps you grow. 当动名词短语作主语时，无论短语内部包含多少名词或代词，谓语动词一律用单数形式，因为整个动名词短语被视为一个整体概念。

肯定句直接使用“动名词短语 + 谓语”结构；否定形式在动名词前加 not，而不是借助助动词，例如：Not getting enough sleep affects your mood. 疑问句则根据时态和语态选择相应的助动词或情态动词置于句首，例如：Does learning English require much practice? 需要注意的是，动名词本身没有时态变化，但可以通过 having done 表示先于谓语动作发生的主动行为，通过 being done 表示被动意义，这在高中书面语中较为常见。

动名词作主语与不定式作主语是高中阶段必须辨析的重点。一般原则是：动名词作主语多表示一般的、习惯性的、抽象的或已知的行为；不定式作主语多表示具体的、一次性的、尚未发生的或将来的行为。例如：Swimming is good exercise.（泛指游泳这项运动）与 To swim across the river now is dangerous.（指现在具体要做的一次行为）。在 It is + 形容词 + ... 句型中，若形容词表示行为性质（如 important, necessary, difficult, possible），通常用不定式作真正主语；若形容词表示情感反应或价值判断（如 useless, worthwhile, no good, a waste of time），则常用动名词。例如：It is important to listen carefully. 与 It is no use crying over spilt milk.

初中阶段主要要求掌握动名词作主语的常见表达，如 Reading is fun. / Playing basketball is my hobby.，并能识别动名词短语作主语时谓语用单数。高中阶段则进一步要求：第一，能在书面表达中灵活使用动名词短语作主语来增强句式的多样性和抽象概括力；第二，能区分动名词与不定式作主语的语义差异；第三，能正确使用动名词的否定式、被动式和完成式；第四，能识别“形式主语 it”与动名词短语的搭配限制，避免在不合适的句型中误用动名词。

易错点一：动名词作主语时，谓语动词的单复数容易受短语末尾名词影响而误用复数。例如：Reading books are interesting. 是错误的，应改为 Reading books is interesting. 易错点二：否定式误用 don't 或 doesn't，如 Don't eating breakfast is bad. 错误，应为 Not eating breakfast is bad. 易错点三：在 It is important / necessary / difficult 等句型中误用动名词作真正主语，如 It is important learning English. 错误，应为 It is important to learn English. 易错点四：把动名词与现在分词混淆。作主语的 -ing 形式是动名词，具有名词功能；而现在分词不能作主语。
forms: 动名词（短语）+ 单数谓语：Learning English takes time.
否定式：Not + 动名词（短语）+ 谓语：Not exercising regularly is harmful.
疑问式：Does/Do/Is/Are + 主语 + 谓语...?：Does cooking at home save money?
完成式（高中）：Having done + 谓语：Having finished the project gave him confidence.
被动式（高中）：Being done + 谓语：Being invited to the conference is an honor.
形式主语 it 句型（高中）：It is no use / no good / worthwhile + 动名词：It is no use arguing with him.
notes: 动名词短语作主语时，谓语动词一律用单数，不受短语内部复数名词影响。
否定式用 Not 置于动名词前，不用 don't / doesn't / didn't。
高考书面语中，动名词作主语常用来表达抽象、概括性观点，比不定式更具客观性和正式感。
在 It is important / necessary / difficult / possible 等表示“行为性质”的形容词后，真正主语用不定式，不用动名词；在 It is no use / no good / worthwhile 等表示“价值判断”的表达后，用动名词。
注意语域差异：动名词作主语在正式书面语中更常见，口语中常改用 it 作形式主语或换用其他句式。

grammar.key: Adverb Clauses of Condition (with 'if') / 条件状语从句（if引导）
grammar.title: if 引导的条件状语从句（含 unless / in case / as long as 等拓展）
grammar.titleEn: Adverb Clauses of Condition (with 'if', including unless / in case / as long as)
grammar.usage:
条件状语从句表示主句动作发生所依赖的条件。if 是最常见的引导词，意为“如果”，从句可以放在主句之前或之后；放在主句之前时，从句后通常用逗号与主句隔开。核心结构为：If + 从句（条件），主句（结果）。肯定句直接使用 if 从句加主句；否定句可在主句或从句中使用否定词，如 If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus；疑问句通常对主句部分提问，如 What will you do if it rains tomorrow?

在时态上，初中阶段要求掌握“主将从现”：当主句用一般将来时或含有情态动词时，if 从句用一般现在时表示将来。高中阶段则进一步拓展到“主情从现”“主祈从现”以及真实条件句与虚拟条件句的区分。真实条件句表示条件可能实现，如 If it snows tomorrow, we will stay at home；虚拟条件句表示与事实相反或不太可能实现的情况，如 If I were you, I would apologize.

与近义结构对比：unless 意为“除非”，相当于 if...not，但语气更强，如 You will fail unless you work harder；in case 意为“以防、万一”，强调预防性条件，如 Take an umbrella in case it rains；as long as / so long as 意为“只要”，强调唯一必要条件，如 You can go out as long as you finish your homework. 这些结构在高考书面表达中交替使用可以提升句式多样性。

易错点：第一，if 引导条件状语从句时不能与 will/would 连用，但 if 引导宾语从句表示“是否”时不受此限制，如 I don't know if he will come. 第二，unless 本身已含否定意义，从句中不再加否定词。第三，虚拟条件句中 be 动词常用 were 代替 was，尤其在书面语中。第四，条件状语从句的位置影响标点：从句在前时用逗号，主句在前时不用逗号。
forms: If + 一般现在时, 主句 will/can/may + 动词原形（主将从现）
If + 一般现在时, 祈使句（主祈从现）
If + 一般现在时, 主句含情态动词（主情从现）
If + 一般过去时, 主句 would/could/might + 动词原形（虚拟条件，与现在事实相反）
If + 过去完成时, 主句 would/could/might + have done（虚拟条件，与过去事实相反）
Unless + 从句, 主句（= If...not...）
notes: 高考书面表达中，if 条件句不要通篇只用“主将从现”一种模式，可适当使用 unless、as long as、in case 等替换，提升句式丰富度。
虚拟条件句是高中语法重点，注意与真实条件句区分：真实条件句讨论可能发生的事，虚拟条件句讨论与事实相反或假设的情况。
在正式书面语中，虚拟条件句的 if 从句若含 were、had、should，可省略 if 并倒装，如 Were I you, I would accept the offer. 这是高考高分句式。
if 引导宾语从句表示“是否”时，时态按实际情况变化，不适用“主将从现”，高考常在此设置干扰项。
unless 本身已含否定意义，从句中不可再加 not，否则会造成双重否定，语义完全改变。

grammar.key: Relative Clauses (who/that) / 定语从句（who/that引导）
grammar.title: 定语从句（who/that 引导）——从基础到高考拓展（含 whom/whose/介词+whom）
grammar.titleEn: Relative Clauses with who/that (Extended to whom/whose/Preposition + whom)
grammar.usage:
定语从句的核心功能是：用一个句子去修饰前面的名词或代词，这个被修饰的词叫“先行词”。当先行词指人时，最常用的关系代词是 who 和 that。who/that 在从句中可以充当主语或宾语。

基本结构为：先行词（人）+ who/that + 从句其余部分。肯定句直接使用该结构；否定句在从句内部否定，如 people who do not sleep well often feel tired；疑问句则把主句变成疑问形式，从句保持陈述语序，如 Do you know the man who is standing there?

who 与 that 在指人时多数情况下可以互换，但存在区别：who 更正式、更常见于书面语；that 在口语中更自然。此外，当先行词被最高级、序数词、the only、the very、all、any 等修饰时，习惯上更倾向于用 that。

初中阶段主要掌握 who/that 作主语和宾语的基本用法，以及作宾语时可省略。高中阶段则需要进一步掌握：who 作宾语时在正式书面语中常变为 whom；介词提前时必须用 whom，如 the person to whom I spoke；whose 表示所属关系，既可指人也可指物；非限制性定语从句中只用 who，不用 that。

易错点一：关系代词作主语时不能省略，且从句谓语动词的数必须与先行词一致。易错点二：从句中已有主语时，关系代词作宾语，口语中可省略，但介词提前时不能省略。易错点三：that 不能用于非限制性定语从句。易错点四：不要在主句中重复先行词的含义，如不能说 The man who he is kind is my uncle。
forms: 先行词（人）+ who + 谓语 + 其他（who 作主语）
先行词（人）+ that + 谓语 + 其他（that 作主语）
先行词（人）+ (who/that) + 主语 + 谓语（who/that 作宾语，可省略）
先行词（人）+ 介词 + whom + 主语 + 谓语（介词提前，whom 不可省）
先行词（人/物）+ whose + 名词 + 谓语（whose 表示所属）
先行词（人），+ who + 谓语 + 其他（非限制性定语从句，不用 that）
notes: 关系代词在从句中作主语时绝对不能省略，且谓语动词要与先行词在人称和数上保持一致。
高考书面语中，作宾语且介词提前时，必须用 whom，不能用 who 或 that，也不能省略。
that 不能引导非限制性定语从句；非限制性定语从句中先行词指人时用 who。
先行词被 the only、the very、序数词、最高级等修饰时，高考语域中更倾向用 that 而非 who。
注意避免从句中重复出现先行词所指代的内容，如不可说 The people who they are lonely...。
